verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents a Hosted Payment Page: a secure, pre-built page hosted by Airwallex that accepts multiple payment methods through a single integration, with custom styling and a quickstart that uses it end to end. Developers can therefore send customers to a vendor-hosted checkout without building their own payment UI. missing for 10: explicit evidence that the hosted page itself is conversion-optimized (the conversion-oriented docs cover the separate Multi-Currency Pricing API), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can redirect customers to a vendor-hosted, conversion-optimized checkout page without building my own payment UI

citations.quote: Hosted Payment Page is a secure, pre-built payment page hosted by Airwallex that lets you accept multiple payment methods with a single integration.
Custom styling rules so you can match the look and feel of your site
Complete a minimal end-to-end online payment in the sandbox environment using Airwallex.js and Airwallex-hosted payment page.
